draft.subject: Your bulk import question - and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for raising the bulk import question - your ticket is still open with Tariq, and he'll follow up with an update there. One thing I can confirm today: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

In the meantime, the fastest way to see what Wrenfield does is a first project - projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
